svg.title: SD08 — Save and Load Game (UC10, UC11; F10; Memento)

g.text: SD08 — Save and Load Game (UC10, UC11; F10; Memento)
one SaveSlotInfo per file: slot, character
invalid JSON is reported as an IOException
[file missing, unreadable or not valid JSON (IOException)]
the current game is left untouched
reloads player, world, quests, event log and
story memory into the existing objects, so
observers and agents keep valid references
